legend.rr: date the RDAP record was read
legend.dc: date the registry record last changed (RDAP "last changed")
legend.iss: issuer of the newest unexpired TLS certificate logged in certificate transparency
legend.cr: date the certificate transparency logs were read

method: One RDAP request per tracked developer domain through the rdap.org bootstrap (registries without RDAP, often country domains, have no date), and one Cert Spotter (SSLMate) query of the certificate transparency logs per domain, within its free hourly limit. Read once and kept; the daily website check (dev_web.py) reads the certificate issuer and the registration date from the handshake and RDAP going forward. Facts as the registry and the logs publish them; no judgement is drawn from a domain's age.
